tools.name: open_live_weather_radar_map
tools.description: Open the interactive live weather radar map with global precipitation tiles and a 2-hour forecast.

tools.name: open_severe_weather_alerts

tools.name: open_weather_radar_for_country
tools.description: Open the RainViewer weather radar page for a specific country. Use when the user asks to see radar, rain, or precipitation for a named country.

countrySlug.description: Lowercase country slug (e.g. "united-states", "germany", "japan"). Spaces are replaced with hyphens.
